title: Isaiah 12
summary: In that day - When this great work of the reduction of Israel, and conversion of the Gentiles is fulfilled.

inlines.v: In that day - When this great work of the reduction of Israel, and conversion of the Gentiles is fulfilled.
God - My salvation hath not been brought to pass by man, but by the almighty power of God.
With joy - Your thirsty souls shall be filled with Divine graces and comforts, which you may draw from God, in the use of gospel - ordinances.
